Atascadero to light up downtown Dec. 4 with Santa, hay rides and holiday shopping 

Posted: 8:13 am, November 10, 2026 by News Staff

Photo by Bruce St. John, courtesy of Visit Atascadero.

Garden Lights & Winter Nights display kicks off at Sunken Gardens

Listen to audio version of this article
Sponsored by
0:00 / 0:52
Instaread

– Downtown Atascadero will kick off the holiday season Friday, Dec. 4, with Light Up the Downtown and Holiday Sip & Shop, running from 5:30 to 8 p.m. at Sunken Gardens.

The evening includes the official lighting and kickoff of the third annual Garden Lights & Winter Nights display, along with community entertainment and a visit from Santa, according to Visit Atascadero.

Visitors can take complimentary rides on a Model-A firetruck and on hay rides, and enjoy hot chocolate. Festivities will continue throughout downtown, where shops will have late hours and participating merchants will offer wine and beer tastings.

Tickets for Holiday Sip & Shop are available through the Atascadero Chamber of Commerce.

For more information, visit www.visitatascadero.com/events.
